violated_contract: A verifier for a reviewed execution manifest must reject admission-added fields that can change execution, confinement or cleanup. Matching only the expected subset must not certify an object carrying unreviewed annotations, finalizers or spec fields.
canonical_prevention: Compare the full execution spec and exact labels/annotations after normalizing only explicitly enumerated API defaults. Reject cleanup-blocking finalizers before execution. Cover both accepted defaults and added-field mutations at preflight and completed-receipt boundaries.
